ezekiel.25.p1.b1.text: Son of man, set your face against the Ammonites and prophesy against them.

ezekiel.25.p1.b3.text: I will make Rabbah a pasture for camels, and Ammon a resting place for sheep. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

ezekiel.25.p1.b4.text: Because Moab and Seir said, “Look, the house of Judah is like all the other nations,” therefore I will indeed expose the flank of Moab beginning with its frontier cities…

ezekiel.25.p1.b5.text: I will stretch out My hand against Edom and cut off from it both man and beast. I will make it a wasteland, and from Teman to Dedan they will fall by the sword.

ezekiel.25.p1.b6.text: I will execute great vengeance against them with furious reproof. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I lay My vengeance upon them.
